build_notes: Hash-locked LGPLv3-or-later shared monthly build. Publisher retains month-end builds for two years; maintenance is still required if availability/policy changes. DLLs/headers download only into the user tool cache; no codec implementation is copied into the MIT profile. Existing verified v3 daily cache remains preserved beside the new content-addressed version.
